boundaries.description: Spiritual Pressure gained from releasing Special Attacks is increased by 100%, and the damage dealt by Special Attacks is increased by 50%.
boundaries.name: Wandering Beast

boundaries.description: For every 1% of Ailment DMG Bonus Kenpachi has, his Crit Rate increases by 0.5%, up to 30%.
boundaries.name: The Name of Kenpachi

boundaries.description: Increases the damage dealt by all Sever Attacks by 30%.
boundaries.name: Fearless Demon

boundaries.description: Each time an on-field enemy is inflicted with Cleave, Kenpachi's Crit DMG and Ailment Mastery are increased by 30% and 20%, respectively, for 30 seconds, stacking up to 2 times.
boundaries.name: Driven to the Edge

corePassives.description: Kenpachi's Special Attack, Spiritual Pressure Burst, and Ultimate are Sever attacks that apply Sever Points to the enemy. Upon reaching 100 Sever Points, the enemy will be inflicted with Cleave. Applying Sever Attacks to a Cleaved enemy deals extra Cleave DMG equal to 20% of that attack, which counts as Ailment DMG, but no longer applies Sever Points.
corePassives.name: Cleave

corePassives.description: While Kenpachi is using Special Attacks, Spiritual Pressure Burst, or his Ultimate, his damage taken is reduced by 60%, and interruption resistance is increased.
corePassives.name: Selfless

corePassives.description: After the battle begins, Kenpachi gains 1 stack of Excitement every 2 seconds. Each stack increases his ATK by 2.5%, stacking up to 10 times.
corePassives.name: Excitement

corePassives.description: Acquiring Frenzy increases the damage of Kenpachi's Special Attacks by 90% for the next 15 seconds. Kenpachi gains 1 Frenzy upon defeating an enemy.
corePassives.name: De-Rust

rotations.name: Battle Lust
rotations.notes: His damage scales with missing HP — let him take a few hits before bursting.

Rampage Raid: Crit Rate +10% for 30s (up to 2 stacks)
ascend5: Casting Ultimate inflicts Cleave (extends by 8s if already Cleaved)
During War Wraith: each basic attack hit increases Kendo DMG by 20%, up to 10 stacks
Spiritual Pressure Burst grants Technique DMG +50% for 5s (up to 2 stacks)
Rampage Raid: Crit Rate +10% for 30s (up to 2 stacks)
